City of Chicago
                                                                   O2022-3958
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                  12/14/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Martin (47)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 11-H at 1616-1630 W
                              Montrose Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                          ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO


        SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the Cl-3 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11-H in the area bounded by

                 The alley next north of and parallel to West Montrose Avenue; a
                 line 221 feet east of and parallel to North Paulina Street; West
                 Montrose Avenue; and a line 43 feet east of and parallel to North
                 Paulina Street

to those ofa B1-3 Neighborhood Shopping District.

        SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and publication.



Common Address:                  1616 to 1630 West Montrose Avenue




                                                                           MATTHEWMARTIN
                                                                           Alderman, 47th Ward
